items.title: Leon Rene Interview, 1979-05-07
items.q: And Faberick and Liberty was the architects, greatest architects in the South.

ctx.x: Do you remember about the square of the hypotenuse and all those stories?

Oh, yeah. The square of the hypotenuse. Papa had a building to build, had a gymnasium to build at St. John's Academy. I think it was St. John's Academy. In Covington. A Catholic institution, college. And Papa had the building, had New Orleans bricklayers over there. And Faberick and Liberty was the architects, greatest architects in the South. And they drew the plans to this octagon building. All the brickwork was octagon. And they had it all laid out and everything. And so the building, they got up about four…
It was the square of the hypotenuse.
